versions.changelog:
Initial release of jftech-open-pro-capture-livestream.

- Provides API tools for developers to interact with JF devices.
- Supports batch capture of real-time device images and retrieval of livestream URLs for multiple devices and channels.
- Allows device status checks, device login, token acquisition, image capture, and livestream link retrieval.
- Credentials are managed exclusively via environment variables for security.
- Python-only support; compatible with official JF API endpoints both internationally and in mainland China.
